They stand watch — and no watch posts itself. In the file I keep a line open for whoever posted it. I pity the birds sincerely; they are the healthiest thing the Reach still has, and they stand in the way of what is necessary. The keeper of the Chronicle may afford pity, but not the detour. The skyway is clear, the storm's core in your hand. We climb on.
quests:chronicle_17:loreText.de: Der große Horst der Rocs ist gestaffelt wie eine Festung: der Horstwächter, die Jagdschwinge, der Älteste und, im Auge des Wetters, der Sturmbringer, dessen Kern mehr Himmel enthält, als einem Vogel zusteht. Eines habe ich erst hier oben begriffen: Ein Nest baut man um die Brut. Dieser Horst ist um den Pass zur Götzenhalle gebaut, alle Augen auf dem einen Weg. Diese Vögel nisten nicht. Sie halten Wache — und eine Wache stellt sich nicht selbst. In der Akte lasse ich eine Zeile frei für den, der sie gestellt hat. Ich bedaure die Vögel aufrichtig. Sie sind das Gesündeste, was das Reach noch hat, und sie stehen dem Nötigen im Weg. Wer die Chronik führt, darf sich das Bedauern leisten, aber nicht den Umweg. Der Himmelsweg ist frei, der Sturmkern liegt in deiner Hand. Wir steigen weiter.

quests:chronicle_18:loreText.en: In the high nesting grounds, where the veil is thinnest, the wyverns brood, and above them waits the Void Roc, half bird, half hole in the world. The void gathers what belongs to the idols the way magpies gather silver, though nobody asked it to. You brought it down, and the high grounds went quiet behind you. Beyond the lair lies only the Hall. I have not written that sentence in a very long time. My hand managed it all the same. Onward, then. I promised this book an ending, and I keep my word.
quests:chronicle_18:loreText.enAlt: In the high nesting grounds, where the veil is thinnest, the wyverns brood, and above them waits the Void Roc, half bird, half hole in the world. The void gathers what belongs to the idols the way magpies gather silver, though nobody asked it to. You brought it down, and the high grounds went quiet behind you. Beyond the lair lies only the Hall. I have not written that sentence in a very long time. The pen managed it all the same. Onward, then — the file wants its ending, and I promised it one.
quests:chronicle_18:loreText.de: In den hohen Nistgründen, wo der Schleier am dünnsten ist, horsten die Wyvern, und über ihnen wartet der Leerenroc, halb Vogel, halb Loch in der Welt. Die Leere sammelt, was den Götzen gehört, wie Elstern Silber sammeln, obwohl niemand sie darum gebeten hat. Du hast ihn bezwungen, und die hohen Nistgründe wurden still hinter dir. Hinter dem Lager liegt nur noch die Halle. Ich habe diesen Satz sehr lange nicht geschrieben. Die Hand hat ihn trotzdem hinbekommen. Also weiter. Ich habe diesem Buch ein Ende versprochen, und das halte ich.

quests:chronicle_19:loreText.en: The full passage, wave upon wave: the Idol's warden, the veil, the scaled wall, and the throne. The Last Idol held no conversation. It held proceedings, and its three blades were its three tenors: Judgement, Vengeance, Condemnation. You have ended the trial the world has conducted against itself since the Idolfall. Behind the throne we found what no iconoclasm ever found: maker's marks in the godiron, set by a hand that was not human. The Last Idol was never the world's judge. It was another's work — and the other is still here. I write with a steady hand, except for one word. Culprit: known.
quests:chronicle_19:loreText.enAlt: The full passage, wave upon wave: the Idol's warden, the veil, the scaled wall, and the throne. The Last Idol held no conversation; it held proceedings, and its three blades were its three tenors: Judgement, Vengeance, Condemnation. You have ended the trial the world has conducted against itself since the Idolfall. Behind the throne we found what no iconoclasm ever found: maker's marks in the god-iron, set by a hand that was not human. The Last Idol was never the world's judge. It was another's work — and the other is still here. I write with a steady hand, except for one word. Culprit: known.
quests:chronicle_19:loreText.de: Der volle Gang, Welle um Welle: der Götzenwächter, der Schleier, die Schuppenwand und der Thron. Der Letzte Götze führte kein Gespräch. Er führte ein Verfahren, und seine drei Klingen waren seine drei Tenöre: Urteil, Vergeltung, Verdammnis. Du hast das Gericht beendet, das die Welt seit dem Bildersturz gegen sich selbst führt. Hinter dem Thron fanden wir, was kein Bildersturm je fand: Werkzeichen im Götzeneisen, gesetzt von einer Hand, die keine menschliche war. Der Letzte Götze war nie der Richter der Welt. Er war das Werk eines anderen — und der andere ist noch da. Ich schreibe mit ruhiger Hand, bis auf ein Wort. Verursacher: bekannt.

quests:chronicle_20:loreText.en: He stepped out of the shadow of his broken masterwork, and the Chronicle received what it never had: a face and a name. Drazhan the Crownless, son of a god and a mortal woman, cheated of both. The idols his siege-works against heaven, mankind never his enemy, only his field. That is what makes him unforgivable. You beat him back, step by step, until the Hall had nothing left to give him. He did not fall. He chose retreat the way a field commander does, and left us his words: “Mark this day. You have seen a retreat, not a fall. When the gods come at last — tell them I started it.” I have written the line this book waited generations for. The first volume closes. The next page is already laid in.
quests:chronicle_20:loreText.enAlt: He stepped out of the shadow of his broken masterwork, and the Chronicle received what it never had: a face and a name. Drazhan the Crownless, son of a god and a mortal woman, cheated of both; the idols his siege-works against heaven, mankind never his enemy, only his field. That is what makes him unforgivable. You beat him back, step by step, until the Hall had nothing left to give him. He did not fall. He chose retreat the way a field commander does, and left us his words: "Mark this day. You have seen a retreat, not a fall. When the gods come at last — tell them I started it." I have written the line this book waited generations for. The first volume closes. The next page is already laid in.
quests:chronicle_20:loreText.de: Er trat aus dem Schatten seines zerbrochenen Meisterstücks, und die Chronik bekam, was sie nie hatte: ein Gesicht und einen Namen. Drazhan der Kronlose, Sohn eines Gottes und einer sterblichen Frau, um beides gebracht. Die Götzen seine Belagerungswerke gegen den Himmel, die Menschheit nie sein Feind, nur sein Acker. Das ist es, was ihn unverzeihlich macht. Du hast ihn zurückgeschlagen, Schritt um Schritt, bis ihm die Halle nichts mehr gab. Er fiel nicht. Er wählte den Rückzug wie ein Feldherr und ließ uns seine Worte da: „Merkt euch diesen Tag. Ihr saht einen Rückzug, keinen Fall. Wenn die Götter endlich kommen — sagt ihnen: Ich habe angefangen.“ Ich habe die Zeile geschrieben, auf die dieses Buch Generationen gewartet hat. Der erste Band schließt. Die nächste Seite ist schon eingelegt.

quests:chronicle_22:description.en: Enter the open Idol Hall and bring down 20 Idol Husks and 12 Skarn Whelps: the second volume does not begin in the tower.
quests:chronicle_22:description.enAlt: Enter the open Idol Hall and bring down Idol Husks and Skarn Whelps: the second volume does not begin in the tower.
quests:chronicle_22:description.de: Betritt die offene Götzenhalle und bezwinge 20 Götzenhülsen und 12 Skarnbrut: Der zweite Band beginnt nicht im Turm.

quests:chronicle_22:loreText.en: I had settled in for floors. Then word came from the Hall, and it came on foot: Drazhan's husks still walk their rounds, because nobody told them the master is gone. A work knows nothing of retreat. It knows only its path. In the rubble of the Sanctum the Skarn's brood has nested by now, and a nest is the surest sign that a place is no longer guarded. You went in as if the Hall were a region like any other, and that is exactly what it is now: a region. I open the second volume at the first page that is not a floor. I do not hesitate. I have written in the Hall before.
quests:chronicle_22:loreText.enAlt: I had settled in for floors. Then word came from the Hall, and it came on foot: Drazhan's husks still walk their rounds, because nobody told them the master is gone. A work knows nothing of retreat. It knows only its path. In the rubble of the Sanctum the Skarn's brood has nested by now, and a nest is the surest sign that a place is no longer guarded. You went in as if the Hall were a region like any other, and that is exactly what it is now: a region. I open the second volume at the first page that is not a floor. The pen does not hesitate. It has written in the Hall before.
quests:chronicle_22:loreText.de: Ich hatte mich auf Etagen eingerichtet. Dann kam die Nachricht aus der Halle, und sie kam zu Fuß: Drazhans Hülsen gehen noch immer ihre Runden, weil niemand ihnen gesagt hat, dass der Meister fort ist. Ein Werk weiß nichts vom Rückzug. Es weiß nur seine Bahn. In den Trümmern des Sanktums nistet inzwischen die Brut des Skarn, und ein Nest ist das sicherste Zeichen, dass ein Ort nicht mehr bewacht wird. Du bist hineingegangen, als wäre die Halle ein Gebiet wie jedes andere, und genau das ist sie jetzt: ein Gebiet. Ich schlage den zweiten Band an der ersten Seite auf, die keine Etage ist. Ich zögere nicht. Ich habe in der Halle schon einmal geschrieben.

quests:chronicle_23:description.en: Confront 12 Idol Priests and 12 Forsaken Servants in the galleries of the Hall: the consecration has to stop.
quests:chronicle_23:description.enAlt: Confront the Idol Priests and their forsaken servants in the galleries of the Hall: the consecration has to stop.
quests:chronicle_23:description.de: Stelle 12 Götzenpriester und 12 Verlassene Diener in den Galerien der Halle: Die Weihe muss aufhören.

quests:chronicle_23:loreText.en: I was the only one who refused to consecrate the new images. The others never left. They stand in the galleries in masks without eyes, swinging their censers, consecrating whatever they find, and whatever they consecrate drinks. Behind them the servants the Stranger left behind: sparks of his fire on chains nobody holds any more. They follow the priests because there is no one else left to follow. I wrote their prayers down. That is my way of listening. They name no god. They do not name Drazhan. They pray into a gap, neatly and with practice, and the gap has a shape. I do not know the shape. That troubles me more than any name would.
quests:chronicle_23:loreText.enAlt: I was the only one who refused to consecrate the new images. The others never left. They stand in the galleries in masks without eyes, swinging their censers, consecrating whatever they find, and whatever they consecrate drinks. Behind them the servants the Stranger left behind: sparks of his fire on chains nobody holds any more. They follow the priests because there is no one else left to follow. I wrote their prayers down; that is my way of listening. They name no god. They do not name Drazhan. They pray into a gap, neatly and with practice, and the gap has a shape. I do not know the shape. That troubles me more than any name would.
quests:chronicle_23:loreText.de: Ich war der Einzige, der sich weigerte, die neuen Bildnisse zu weihen. Die anderen sind nie gegangen. Sie stehen in den Galerien mit Masken ohne Augen, schwenken ihre Gefäße und weihen, was sie finden, und was sie weihen, trinkt. Hinter ihnen die Diener, die der Fremde zurückließ: Funken seines Feuers an Ketten, die niemand mehr hält. Sie folgen den Priestern, weil sonst niemand da ist, dem sie folgen könnten. Ich habe ihre Gebete mitgeschrieben, das ist meine Art zuzuhören. Sie nennen keinen Gott. Sie nennen nicht Drazhan. Sie beten in eine Lücke hinein, sauber und geübt, und die Lücke hat eine Form. Ich kenne die Form nicht. Das beunruhigt mich mehr als jeder Name.

quests:chronicle_24:description.en: Hunt 15 Prayer Eaters in the lower galleries: the harvest nobody collected is walking.
quests:chronicle_24:description.enAlt: Hunt the Prayer Eaters in the lower galleries: the harvest nobody collected is walking.
quests:chronicle_24:description.de: Jage 15 Gebetsfresser in den unteren Galerien: Die Ernte, die niemand abholte, geht um.

quests:chronicle_24:loreText.en: In the Ashfields I taught you the core lesson: nothing the idols drank ever reached the gods. I left out the addendum then, because I did not know it. Nothing was lost. Drazhan harvested what flowed to him, but a commander in retreat leaves the barns standing. In the lower galleries, what was never collected now walks: prayers that have taken shape, sated, heavy, full of strangers' voices. A Prayer Eater does not speak. It repeats. I heard a plea for rain older than I am, and I am old. You silenced them, every one you found. It was mercy, not victory. I record both.
quests:chronicle_24:loreText.enAlt: In the Ashfields I taught you the core lesson: nothing the idols drank ever reached the gods. I left out the addendum then, because I did not know it. Nothing was lost. Drazhan harvested what flowed to him, but a commander in retreat leaves the barns standing. In the lower galleries, what was never collected now walks: prayers that have taken shape, sated, heavy, full of strangers' voices. A Prayer Eater does not speak. It repeats. I heard a plea for rain older than I am, and I am old. You silenced them, every one you found. It was mercy, not victory. The Chronicle records both.
quests:chronicle_24:loreText.de: In den Aschfeldern habe ich dir die Kernlektion beigebracht: Nichts, was die Götzen tranken, kam je bei den Göttern an. Den Nachsatz habe ich damals weggelassen, weil ich ihn nicht kannte. Nichts ging verloren. Drazhan erntete, was ihm zufloss, aber ein Feldherr auf dem Rückzug lässt die Scheunen stehen. In den unteren Galerien geht jetzt um, was nie abgeholt wurde: Gebete, die Gestalt angenommen haben, satt, schwer, voller fremder Stimmen. Ein Gebetsfresser spricht nicht. Er wiederholt. Ich habe eine Bitte um Regen gehört, die älter ist als ich, und ich bin alt. Du hast sie zum Schweigen gebracht, alle, die du gefunden hast. Es war Gnade, nicht Sieg. Ich vermerke beides.

quests:daily_ma_kill_total_60:descriptio.en: Defeat 60 monsters in a single day: let the Reach know your name.
quests:daily_ma_kill_total_60:descriptio.enAlt: Defeat 60 monsters in a single day — let the realm know your name.
quests:daily_ma_kill_total_60:descriptio.de: Besiege 60 Monster an einem einzigen Tag: Das Reach soll deinen Namen kennen.

quests:daily_ma_kill_roc_20:description.en: Bring down 20 rocs that rule the Highland skies.
quests:daily_ma_kill_roc_20:description.enAlt: Bring down 20 rocs terrorizing the Highland skies.
quests:daily_ma_kill_roc_20:description.de: Erlege 20 Rocs, die den Himmel über dem Hochland beherrschen.

quests:daily_ma_kill_idol_warden_15:desc.en: Break the line of 15 idol wardens guarding the Idol Hall.
quests:daily_ma_kill_idol_warden_15:desc.enAlt: Break the line of 15 idol wardens guarding the Idol Sanctum.
quests:daily_ma_kill_idol_warden_15:desc.de: Durchbrich die Reihen von 15 Götzenwächtern in der Götzenhalle.

quests:daily_ma_kill_aether_wraith_10:de.en: Unmake 10 aether wraiths bound within the Idol Hall.
quests:daily_ma_kill_aether_wraith_10:de.enAlt: Unmake 10 aether wraiths bound within the Idol Sanctum.
quests:daily_ma_kill_aether_wraith_10:de.de: Löse 10 Aetherwraiths in der Götzenhalle auf.

quests:daily_ma_kill_scale_skarn_8:descr.en: Bring down 8 dragonhide skarns lairing in the Idol Hall.
quests:daily_ma_kill_scale_skarn_8:descr.enAlt: Bring down 8 dragonhide skarns lairing in the Idol Sanctum.

quests:daily_ma_smelt_godiron_3:descript.en: Smelt 3 godiron bars: the final rung of the metal ladder.
quests:daily_ma_smelt_godiron_3:descript.enAlt: Smelt 3 godiron bars — the final rung of the metal ladder.
quests:daily_ma_smelt_godiron_3:descript.de: Schmelze 3 Götzeneisenbarren: die letzte Sprosse der Metallleiter.

quests:daily_ma_gather_400:description.en: Gather 400 items in a single day: the Reach still has plenty to give.
quests:daily_ma_gather_400:description.enAlt: Gather 400 items in a single day — the realm still has plenty to give.
quests:daily_ma_gather_400:description.de: Sammle 400 Gegenstände an einem einzigen Tag: Das Reach hat noch viel zu geben.

quests:daily_ma_kill_total_80:descriptio.en: Defeat 80 monsters in a single day: a reckoning fit for the late chapters.
quests:daily_ma_kill_total_80:descriptio.enAlt: Defeat 80 monsters in a single day — a reckoning fit for the late chapters.
quests:daily_ma_kill_total_80:descriptio.de: Besiege 80 Monster an einem einzigen Tag: eine Abrechnung, wie sie zu den späten Kapiteln passt.

talentTrees:slayer:description.en: Brenna's ledger of the hunt. Slayer points spent here become permanent upgrades for every run you play.
talentTrees:slayer:description.enAlt: Brenna's ledger of the hunt. Slayer points spent here become permanent upgrades for your whole account.
talentTrees:slayer:description.de: Brennas Buch der Jagd. Hier ausgegebene Slayer-Punkte werden zu bleibenden Verbesserungen für jeden deiner Durchgänge.

talentNodes:slayer.trail:description.en: After {value} the expected number of failed rolls for a companion you are missing, your next roll for it is guaranteed.
talentNodes:slayer.trail:description.enAlt: After {value} the expected number of attempts without a companion, your next roll is guaranteed.

talentNodes:slayer.collar:description.en: Unlocks a second companion slot. There, only the skill effect works, not the combat ability.
talentNodes:slayer.collar:description.enAlt: Unlocks a second companion slot. Only its passive effect applies there.

talentNodes:slayer.pace:description.en: Completed Slayer tasks pay {value} more Slayer points.
talentNodes:slayer.pace:description.enAlt: Completed tasks pay {value} more Slayer points.

talentNodes:slayer.lore:description.en: You deal {value} more damage to a monster family once you have defeated every monster in it at least once.
talentNodes:slayer.lore:description.enAlt: You deal {value} more damage to monster families whose bestiary is complete.

talentNodes:prestige.keepBankStacks:desc.en: You choose {value} stacks of materials or consumables to survive the Cinderfall, up to 50 of each. What was buried never saw the fire.
talentNodes:prestige.keepBankStacks:desc.enAlt: {value} stacks of materials or consumables survive the Cinderfall, up to 50 of each. What was buried never saw the fire.

talentNodes:prestige.keepEquipment:descr.en: You choose {value} pieces of equipment to survive the Cinderfall, each with a requirement of level 80 or more. Tools and master rings are excluded. A piece the ash does not get.
talentNodes:prestige.keepEquipment:descr.enAlt: Chosen equipment survives the Cinderfall (pieces: {value}) if each piece requires level 80 or more. A piece the ash does not get.

talentNodes:prestige.chronicleRecall:des.en: You can complete Chronicle chapters 1 to 18 with a click, one after another. They pay half the gold, and no tokens, items or XP. The Chronicle will not read you a chapter you have already lived.
talentNodes:prestige.chronicleRecall:des.enAlt: Chronicle chapters 1 to 18 that you have lived through can be completed with a click, for half the gold and without tokens or items. The Chronicle will not read you a chapter you have already lived.

talentNodes:prestige.masteredXp:descript.en: {value} more skill XP up to level 99 in skills you have taken to level 99 before. Your hands still know where to reach.
talentNodes:prestige.masteredXp:descript.enAlt: {value} more skill XP up to level 99 in skills you have mastered before. Your hands still know where to reach.

talentNodes:prestige.dungeonRecall:descr.en: Dungeons you have cleared before are open to you at once, even if their quest or zone is still locked. The Paragon Spire is excluded. Gates you have cleared once know you.
talentNodes:prestige.dungeonRecall:descr.enAlt: Dungeons you cleared in an earlier run are open to you at once. Gates you have cleared once know you.

talentNodes:prestige.goldFind:descriptio.en: {value} more gold from actions, fights, dungeons, quests, hunting and the tavern, but not from selling. You gather what belonged to the idols, the way magpies gather silver.
talentNodes:prestige.goldFind:descriptio.enAlt: {value} more gold from actions, fights, dungeons and quests, but not from selling. You gather what belonged to the idols, the way magpies gather silver.
